title: Coordinate formula for a matrix operator
statement: Let $A$ be a real matrix indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)$ and let $v\in\mathbb{R}^n$ with the Euclidean norm. For each index $i$, the $i$th coordinate of the operator associated with $A$ applied to $v$ is $\sum_j A_{ij}v_j$.
hypotheses_covered: A is a real matrix indexed by Fin(n)
v is a vector in Euclidean space indexed by Fin(n)
i is an index in Fin(n)
